Relay Works

Presentations2026

A corporate deck that makes an unfamiliar service easy to explain.

STATUS
Self-initiated concept
ROLE
Art direction, design and production study
OUTPUT
Editable vector layouts / PDF / PowerPoint

CONTEXT / PROBLEM

Operations consulting can sound abstract. The deck needs to show the handoffs and decisions a team will make.

Creative direction

Deep green and warm orange frame direct headings and open layouts. Information gets space before decoration.

The system

Thirteen slides covering company, problem, solution, services, process, KPIs, timeline, roles, scenario and next step.

PRODUCTION / DELIVERY

Made to be used again.

Native PowerPoint chart, table, text and diagrams. Three reusable master layouts. All figures are illustrative.

Design outcome

The finished study demonstrates a repeatable design system and production-aware decisions. No measured business result is claimed.
